# Cross-cutting requirements (definition of done for every feature)

A feature that misses one of these is not shippable (PRD v2 §05).


## X1 · Security

- MFA for all staff; passkeys preferred; session timeout on shared PCs
- Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest; Always Encrypted for national IDs and insurance member numbers; TDE with customer-managed key
- Private endpoints; no public database; managed identities instead of secrets; remaining secrets only in Key Vault
- Rate limiting middleware, CSP, HSTS, BFF cookies, antiforgery; FluentValidation on every input

## X2 · Privacy and compliance

- DPDP Act and 2025 Rules (India); UAE health-data law, ADHICS and emirate rules
- Consent, privacy notices, retention rules and data-subject requests
- No PHI in logs, analytics or error monitoring
- Legal review before each new class of real data (P1, P2, P3)

## X3 · Clinical safety

- Allergy never conveyed by colour alone; patient identity always on screen
- Hard stop on uncertain patient match
- Unknowns are left blank, never inferred
- Clinical incident review process from P2

## X4 · Every-flow states

- First-use, empty, loading/slow, error, unauthorised, offline, no-consent
- Large text (200% zoom), mobile and print
- Safe recovery: no data loss on refresh or network drop

## X5 · Accessibility and language

- WCAG 2.2 AA, keyboard and screen-reader support
- English, Hindi and Arabic with full RTL from P0; Malayalam in AI from P6
- Touch targets ≥ 44 px on tablet and mobile

## X6 · Performance

- Page interactive < 2.5 s (p75) on a typical clinic PC
- API p95 < 300 ms for reads, < 600 ms for writes
- Booking correct under concurrency, not just fast

## X7 · Reliability and data

- Daily encrypted backups, PITR, monthly restore test
- RPO ≤ 15 min, RTO ≤ 4 h from P5
- Forward-only reviewed migrations; reversible imports

## X8 · Quality and observability

- xUnit + Testcontainers (SQL Server), Vitest for UI, Playwright E2E for each journey
- OpenTelemetry → Application Insights with PHI scrubbing
- Each feature behind a tenant flag with an owner

# Success metrics

Measured from pilot onward. Baselines are captured at each partner clinic in P1 before Medvya changes their workflow. Clinical outcomes are not claimed.

| Metric | Target | From | How measured |
|---|---|---|---|
| Check-in time (returning patient) | ≤ 60 s median; ≤ 30 s with ID reader | P1 | Event timestamps from arrival to checked-in |
| No-show rate | −25% vs clinic baseline | P1 | Baseline from first 2 weeks; reminders and confirmations |
| Double bookings | 0 | P1 | Constraint violations and support tickets |
| Time to signed note | −40% vs P2 manual baseline | P3 | Encounter end to signature |
| AI drafts signed with minor edits | ≥ 80% | P3 | Edit distance + clinician rating |
| Fabricated medication or dose | 0 | P3 | Evaluation set and clinician reports |
| Abnormal results acknowledged in 72 h | 100% | P4 | Results inbox state history |
| Day-end close variance | 0 unexplained | P4 | Cash close records |
| Clinic activation | 50 appointments in first 14 days | P5 | Per new tenant |
| Go-live time after contract | ≤ 2 weeks | P5 | Contract date to cutover |
| Logo retention | ≥ 90% at 6 months | P5 | Paying clinics still active |

# Release and delivery process

1. **Scope freeze.** Requirement IDs for the phase locked; changes go to the next phase unless safety-critical.
2. **Staging acceptance.** Playwright journeys green; exit criteria checked on synthetic data; security scan clean.
3. **Pilot on flags.** Recipients get the release behind tenant flags; daily check-ins for the first week.
4. **Exit gate review.** Founder, clinical advisor and one pilot user confirm each exit criterion with evidence.
5. **Handover.** Delivery package sent: release notes, training, runbook, known issues. Phase closed.

- **Environments:** Local (Docker Compose) → preview per pull request → staging (synthetic data) → production per country. Production deploys only from tagged releases on protected main.
- **Feature flags:** every phase ships behind per-tenant flags. Pilot clinics receive features before general availability. A flag can be turned off without a redeploy.
- **Versioning:** R0–R4 are pilot releases (0.x). R5 is v1.0 general availability. Later phases ship as minor versions. Database migrations are forward-only and reviewed.
